name: Fellowship Scholarship Scheme
benefit: - **Annual Scholarship:** Financial assistance is provided every year to eligible students.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must have secured at least 70% marks in Class 10th. - The applicant must be pursuing higher secondary school (Class 11th onwards), college, or higher education. - The applicant’s personal/ family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
